scope: Local application verification with fixture model proposals and MOCK payments; chaincode race and static checks
repairs: Upgraded Next.js from 15.5.24 to 15.5.27 for two cache-poisoning advisories.
Raised sharp override to >=0.35.5 and source-map-js override to >=1.2.2.
Pinned all postcss-selector-parser copies, including postcss-nested's copy, to 7.1.6.
Retained a pnpm patch for braces 3.0.3 that rejects excessive brace and parenthesis nesting before recursive AST traversal.
Added five regression tests covering parse, compile, expand, stringify and ordinary nested glob behavior.
Updated README verification evidence and placed the production build before the browser test command.

full_dependency_audit.limitation: The local guard bounds AST depth for parsed string patterns. Directly caller-constructed AST objects are not validated. Audit remains nonzero and the advisory is not suppressed.

initial_failures: Four secret-scanner CLI tests failed because spawnSync returned EPERM in the sandbox. The unrestricted full suite passed without changing the scanner.
A TypeScript check overlapped with Next's regeneration of .next/types. Sequential verification after the completed build passed.
The initial full dependency audit reported six advisories: three high and three moderate. Five were removed through dependency upgrades; the remaining development advisory has a local mitigation.
Four new nesting-limit regressions failed before applying the braces patch and passed afterward.
limits: The fresh ledger-backed Drunix demo is blocked: stopped Docker containers reference missing identity and configuration directories under /tmp.
Live model calls were not repeated; provider behavior was tested through the existing mocked regression suite.
Razorpay calls were not repeated; prior HTTP 401 credential rejection remains recorded in docs/verification-2026-10-02.md.
Passing suites are not exhaustive coverage; Go statement coverage is 14.3%.
Detailed logs are local temporary artifacts and may be removed by host cleanup.
